# Erdem Süren

> Product Engineer · .NET, Next.js, React Native. System architecture, back end, mobile, DevOps. Founder of Eribitech. İstanbul, Türkiye.

- Builds systems end to end: architecture, back end, web, mobile, servers and network.
- BELBİM, Software Development Specialist: built the headless CMS (modular monolith, Clean Architecture), belbim.istanbul and istanbulkart.istanbul (Next.js 15) and the servers' Next.js configuration. İstanbulkart mobile app (React Native): connected the integrations and built the updates; in its back end, version-based content sync with RabbitMQ, Redis, Hangfire and FluentValidation. Now building the DevOps system.
- Eribitech, Founder: Eribi (e-commerce), Eribi Growth and Eribi Creative on a microservice architecture (9 services behind YARP).
- İGDAŞ, Software Developer: built the Operations Automation System (24/7, field teams) and the Medical Supply Tracking (TMT) app. SAP S/4HANA integration.
- Tiramisu Studios, Game Developer: Drift Max Pro (120M+ downloads) and Drift Max City.

Turkish at https://erdemsuren.com/, English under https://erdemsuren.com/en/.
